records.statement: Annular aperture with 37 physical angular cells, 288 mm outer diameter, 188 mm inner diameter, stationary hardware with traveling phase patterns and no mechanical rotation.
Run mask 35 of 37, steering condition 33 active, inactive and open sector steering asymmetry.
4096 Hz phase authority; right-hand winding maps to +90 degree quadrature, left-hand winding maps to -90 degree quadrature; coil tilt approximately 45 to 50 degrees from vertical.

Outer sector pitch = pi x 0.288 m / 37 = 24.453478 mm approximately; one guided period per sector at 1683456 Hz gives a loaded slow-wave phase velocity near 41000 m/s, far below free-space electromagnetic speed.

Frequency spine role assignment: 4096 Hz phase authority; 1683456 Hz annular external resonance; 1695000 Hz Earth or outer-envelope lane candidate; 1600000 Hz rounded ring or injection geometry candidate; 13183593.75 Hz craft operating carrier candidate; 20480 Hz and 40960 Hz crystal burst controls. One role per value, no role sharing.
H-ME-SSP-001 measurement protocol reference: all null controls required before any response is interpreted; see h_me_ssp_001_protocol.json for the control list.

Refused public claims for every craft-path record: thrust, lift, antigravity, gravity control, barycentric field coupling, reactionless propulsion, free energy, source authentication, validated craft performance. No record in this registry advances any of these.
